questions.question_text:
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.8]\draw[-{Stealth}] (0,0)--(3,0);\fill (0,0) circle (2pt) node[below] {$A$};\fill (2,0) circle (2pt) node[below] {$B$};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
Which name matches the object shown?

options.why: Ray $BA$ starts at $B$ and passes through $A$. The shown ray starts at $A$ and passes through $B$.
An interval stops at its two endpoints. The arrow shows that this ray continues beyond $B$.
A line continues in both directions. The shown ray has one endpoint, $A$.

questions.question_text: Which ray starts at $Q$ and passes through $R$?

options.why: Writes the through-point first and the endpoint second, reversing the naming convention for a ray.
An interval stops at $Q$ and $R$ rather than continuing from $Q$ through $R$.
A line continues in both directions. A ray has one endpoint.

questions.question_text:
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.8]\coordinate (B) at (0,0);\coordinate (A) at (2,0);\coordinate (C) at (1,1.8);\draw (A)--(B)--(C);\node[right] at (A) {$A$};\node[below] at (B) {$B$};\node[above] at (C) {$C$};\draw (0.5,0) arc[start angle=0,end angle=61,radius=0.5];\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
Which is a valid name for the marked angle?

options.why: Puts $C$ in the middle even though $B$ is the vertex.
Puts $A$ in the middle even though $B$ is the vertex.
Uses three diagram letters but does not centre the vertex.

questions.question_text: In $\angle LMN$, which point is the vertex?

options.why: Chooses the first arm point instead of the middle vertex.
Chooses the second arm point instead of the middle vertex.

questions.question_text: What do matching double arcs on two angles show?

options.why: Confuses curved angle arcs with straight interval tick marks.
Treats an angle mark as notation about ray direction.
Treats equal angle measures as the same physical point.
